errorCard.body.fileInUse.clearData: Something else on your computer is holding one of SavePoint's files open, so it couldn't be removed. Everything else was removed. Close any program that is using the snapshot folder, then delete what's left yourself.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.freeUpSpace: Something else on your computer is holding one of the snapshot folder's files open, so freeing up space stopped. Close any program that is using that folder, such as a backup tool, then free up space again.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.moveSnapshots: Something else on your computer is holding one of the old snapshot files open, so SavePoint couldn't remove it. Your snapshots moved and SavePoint uses the new folder. Close any program that is using the old folder, then delete what's left yourself.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.snapshot: Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open, so SavePoint couldn't finish this snapshot. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. Your earlier snapshots are untouched.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.switch: Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. SavePoint picks up where it left off and won't redo the work it already finished.
errorCard.body.noRoom.freeUpSpace: There's not enough free disk space to free up space right now. {os, select, windows {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on drive {drive} and try again.} other {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on the disk that holds the folder below and try again.}}
errorCard.body.noRoom.moveSnapshots: There's not enough free disk space to move your snapshots there. {os, select, windows {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on drive {drive} and try again.} other {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on the disk that holds the folder below and try again.}} Nothing was moved.
errorCard.body.noRoom.snapshot: There's not enough free disk space to take this snapshot right now. {os, select, windows {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on drive {drive} and try again.} other {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on the disk that holds the folder below and try again.}}
errorCard.body.noRoom.switch: There's not enough free disk space to switch right now. {os, select, windows {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on drive {drive} and try again.} other {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on the disk that holds the folder below and try again.}}
errorCard.copied: Copied. Paste it into your bug report.
errorCard.copyFailed: SavePoint couldn't reach the clipboard. Try again.
errorCard.detailsExplanation: These are technical details for a bug report. They can be long and hard to read, and they can include file names and folder paths from this computer, so SavePoint doesn't show them here. Copy them and paste them into your report.
